reviews.comment: Installed in ps5 runs like a dream play games off it not glitches or slowdowns same as if it was on the system!

reviews.title: Bought for PS5 digital
reviews.comment: With only 1TB with a PS5 digital I ordered a 2TB. Before purchace when I would do a network check my DL speed was roughly 40-60mbps. Right after the quick and easy install I ran a network check and the DL speed was 400 mbps + not to mention a great price!
reviews.author: Bryan

reviews.title: Great NVME for PS5!
reviews.comment: I bought this to add more storage to my PS5 and it’s perfect. The heatsink that comes with fits perfectly in my PS5. Very good speeds, it downloads my games very quick. No overheating issues.
reviews.author: Andrew G.

reviews.comment: Holds a lot of games for my ps5

reviews.title: Fortnite Stutters Occasionally
reviews.comment:
Very easy to plop inside, has the listed  write speed and storage amount.
The only thing I’ve noticed is how Fortnite has stuttered since it’s been moved onto this SSD. It only happens occasionally after 2-4 hours of playing local multiplayer Fortnite. Assumably it could be because of heat but it still performs well otherwise.
reviews.author: Scar
